rv.q: Bedlam's electrifying D.I.Y. 'Othello' at the Theater will better fit your needs
Such is the skill of these actors, they shape shift between characters seamlessly, delivering the play’s operatic scale and human drama with fingertip immediacy.
Tucker's Othello is a bell-ringing winner and, to mix metaphors, a lengthy feather in Bedlam's cap.
This is a good, unique, and smart Othello, but it lacks the fun that undergirds much of Bedlam's past successes.
Tucker introduces several interesting ideas about the text without significant trims
